data.notes: December 2026 is led by big Latin and urban arena/stadium dates, while the strongest travel-worthy club programming clusters around Costanera open-air electronic events and Niceto’s indie/underground calendar.

events.title: Maná — Vivir Sin Aire Tour
events.summary: The official promoter release confirms Maná at Estadio River Plate on December 10, 2026, for the Vivir Sin Aire Tour. The Buenos Aires stadium date is billed as the band’s only Argentina show of 2026.

events.title: New Order + Tricky
events.summary: New Order’s official tour schedule lists a Buenos Aires date at Mandarine Park on December 1, 2026, with Tricky also billed on local event listings. The booking is a major alternative/electronic-rock draw for the month.

events.title: RAVE3000 Festival 2026
events.summary: Repitch Republic’s RAVE3000 closes the year with a 12-hour, multi-stage outdoor festival spanning hard techno, house, trance, pop and Buenos Aires alternative club culture, with Arca, Patrick Mason, Cera Khin, Cristobal Pesce, LESSSS, Kessler and more listed.

events.title: Anuel AA en Argentina 2026
events.summary: The official Linke-Arte ticketing page confirms Anuel AA at Tecnópolis on December 3, 5 and 6, 2026, at 21:30. The run is a major Latin trap/reggaeton booking just outside the city line in Villa Martelli.

events.title: Omar Courtz — Por Si Mañana No Estoy World Tour
events.summary: Movistar Arena’s official event page confirms Omar Courtz on December 2, 3 and 4, 2026, following an additional November 30 date. The Puerto Rican urbano artist brings the Por Si Mañana No Estoy tour to one of Buenos Aires’ main indoor arenas.

events.title: NO ART Buenos Aires: ANOTR, Prospa, Mateo Dufour, Ludmila Di Pasquale
events.summary: Amsterdam house label and touring party brand NO ART makes its Argentina debut at Ciudad Universitaria, led by ANOTR with Prospa plus local selectors Mateo Dufour and Ludmila Di Pasquale.

events.title: Daniel Caesar — Son of Spergy Tour
events.summary: Live Nation confirms Daniel Caesar’s Son of Spergy Tour at Estadio Obras in Buenos Aires on Saturday, December 5, 2026. It is the month’s strongest confirmed R&B booking.

events.title: NO ART | ANOTR & More
events.summary: Sold Out confirms NO ART at Ciudad Universitaria on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 17:00 to 01:30, with ANOTR named in the event title. The Amsterdam party brand’s open-air Buenos Aires date is a notable house/electronic booking.

events.title: Paul van Dyk with Ferry Corsten
events.summary: Sold Out confirms Paul van Dyk at Oasis Open Air on Saturday, December 5, 2026, with Ferry Corsten listed on the lineup. The event is promoted by Sunrise and runs overnight from 00:00 to 06:00.

events.title: #8D Cumple ATR — Damas Gratis en Vivo
events.summary: Passline’s Museum Live venue page lists “#8D cumple ATR - Damas Gratis en Vivo” on December 8, 2026, at 21:00. The cumbia villera institution is a signature Buenos Aires-area live pick for the month.

events.title: Saramalacara — La Ejecución Pública
events.summary: CoolCo’s ticketing page confirms Saramalacara at Estadio Obras Sanitarias on December 18, 2026, from 21:00 to 23:00. The show closes the Mataderos World Tour 2026 with a career-spanning performance titled La Ejecución Pública.

events.title: PM Pres. Green Velvet
events.summary: Sold Out confirms PM Pres. Green Velvet at Oasis Open Air on Friday, December 4, 2026, running from 00:00 to 07:00. The lineup page lists Green Velvet with PM Open Air and Fragment as promoters.

events.title: Green Velvet x PM! Open Air
events.summary: PM Open Air / Fragment hosts Chicago house-techno figure Green Velvet for an open-air Punta Carrasco night.

events.title: Korolova pres. Captive Soul at FCN
events.summary: Korolova brings the Captive Soul concept to Foro Costanera Norte for a late-night melodic/progressive electronic session.

events.title: Shintaro Sakamoto en Niceto Club
events.summary: El Cartel’s event page confirms Shintaro Sakamoto at Niceto Club on Tuesday, December 8, 2026, from 20:00 to 23:59. The listing frames the show around his psychedelic, funky solo-pop catalog and new album material.

events.title: Sara Hebe presenta Negocionismo
events.summary: Indie Hoy confirms Sara Hebe at Niceto Club on Saturday, December 19, 2026, at 20:00. The Buenos Aires rapper returns to present her seventh studio album, Negocionismo, with Sylvia Pop and DJs opening.

events.title: Mushroom Christmas Edition
events.summary: Mushroom’s Christmas Edition is listed as a holiday electronic party at the Estadio Nacional de Beisbol in Ezeiza, extending the Buenos Aires metro club calendar into Christmas night.

events.title: Jay de Lys at Río Electronic Music
events.summary: Buenos Aires tech-house date for Jay de Lys at Río Electronic Music, listed by local electronic-ticketing platforms for the December club calendar.

events.title: BABYMETAL WORLD TOUR 2026 LATIN AMERICA in Buenos Aires
events.summary: BABYMETAL’s official tour page lists a Buenos Aires stop at Movistar Arena on December 1, 2026 as part of the Latin America run. Ticket sale windows are also listed on the official page.

events.title: Tan Biónica en Estadio Uno
events.summary: Livepass confirms Tan Biónica at Estadio UNO in La Plata on December 12, 2026 at 21:00, billing it as the band’s closing show of 2026. La Plata is just outside Buenos Aires and functions as a major regional stadium stop.

events.title: Rata Blanca at Movistar Arena
events.summary: Songkick lists Rata Blanca as headliner at Movistar Arena in Buenos Aires on December 2, 2026. The show is a major hometown arena date for the Argentine hard rock/heavy metal band.

events.title: Tarja Turunen — The Spirit of Christmas 2026
events.summary: Tarja Turunen’s official site confirms a Buenos Aires concert at Teatro Coliseo on December 1, 2026. The show is tied to her The Spirit of Christmas 2026 presentation.

events.title: Dominguinho en Argentina
events.summary: Brazilian project Dominguinho—featuring João Gomes, Jota.Pê and Mestrinho—makes its first Argentina appearance at C Art Media, a notable Brazilian/Latin diaspora booking outside the arena circuit.

events.title: Gerónimo Rauch at Teatro Gran Rex
events.summary: TuEntrada’s official sales page confirms Gerónimo Rauch at Teatro Gran Rex on December 10, 2026 at 20:30. The concert is listed as a Buenos Aires date for the Argentine musical-theatre vocalist.

events.title: DM Experience at Teatro Gran Rex
events.summary: TuEntrada’s official sales page confirms DM Experience at Teatro Gran Rex on December 18, 2026 at 20:00. The Gran Rex booking makes it a solid theatre-scale pick for Depeche Mode/electronic-pop fans.

events.title: Fiesta en Barco | De Pary Aloha
events.summary: A tropical-themed end-of-year boat party with dinner, navigation and dancing aboard a catamaran, programming cachengue, cumbia, old-school reggaeton and Brazilian music for a small-capacity river-party crowd.
